column1: # Real sample files for the decoders and containers the host ffmpeg cannot write (no encoder or
# muxer), from FFmpeg's public sample suite https://samples.ffmpeg.org/. Read by
# run-sample-tests.sh; the results are in SAMPLES.md. Columns, tab separated:
#   name        a directory name of its own under the samples dir
#   path        below https://samples.ffmpeg.org/ (the file itself is never committed)
#   prepare     "-" or "gunzip" (the server keeps that file gzipped)
#   decoders    comma list of decoder:kind (v video, a audio, V video forced onto the first picture
#               stream whatever codec the container names, for h263p), "-" for none; a trailing "!"
#               marks a decoder this build is known not to have (the test expects "no such decoder")
#   demux       "yes" when the container is read by FfmpegExtractor (ffdemux.h), "-" when Media3's own
#               extractor (MP4, AVI, FLV, WAV, MP3) or nothing in the app reads it
